blind.description: A decorative architectural corbel or wall shelf bracket sculpted with Lovecraftian tentacles. It features a flat rectangular top shelf with a bevelled front lip, a vertical side panel decorated with tentacle relief carvings, and curling tentacles with visible suckers serving as the structural bracket underneath. The surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no holes or disconnected floating elements. The material resembles stylized dusty purple or lavender stone with soft painted shading.
blind.from_above: A simple flat purple rectangle with a thin lipped border along one long edge, casting a shadow towards the top-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/3 the height of the figure (roughly 1.8 to 2 feet tall) and roughly 1.5 to 2 feet wide.
